post.description: Verifies a response organization against the current immutable official-channel authority assertion selected by officialChannelSourceId. The identifier is never a raw communication endpoint verification or document evidence identifier; the owner requires an active, unexpired and unrevoked assertion and revalidates its exact EMAIL domain-control or DOCUMENT official-representation binding in the transaction. Missing authority and OTP-only proof fail closed.
Records one immutable human personhood classification for an agency or supplier from a reviewed public-source locator. It never infers natural-person status automatically.

Attests material-use closure only after all referring contracts have passed their Asia/Seoul end-of-day boundary, every public revision naming the entity is superseded or retracted, and no legal hold is active.

Creates one immutable organization official-channel authority receipt and registry assertion after an independent human reviewer revalidates the current EMAIL_LINK endpoint proof or VERIFIED/PUBLIC official document source. Caller-supplied authority digests and OTP-only proof are forbidden.
Appends an immutable revocation receipt for a current official-channel assertion. It never deletes or rewrites the authority receipt or registry history.

Creates one immutable sealed correction plan only for the exact RESPONSE `/partyName` cell after re-reading the same subject-bound ACCESS projection and current-value digest. Every other object-kind and field-path pair is rejected as PRIVACY_CORRECTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED with zero writes.

ActorAssertion.name: X-Gurine-Actor-Assertion
ActorAssertion.description: Single-use Gurine actor assertion v1, bound to method, normalized path, canonical query and exact request-body SHA-256.

autoUpgradeConflict.description: true when automatic upgrade is enabled and two or more active models with created timestamps share the latest created timestamp in the provider track; no model is selected automatically.

namedIndividualOverride.description: Present only for the second, STEP_UP LEGAL_REVIEWER stage; the first independent editorial APPROVE must omit it and grants no publish authority.

officialChannelSourceId.description: Identifier of the current immutable official-channel authority assertion. It is never a raw communication endpoint verification ID or official document evidence ID.

verifyResponseOrganizationIdentityReques.description: Verifies a response organization against one current immutable official-channel authority assertion. The owner revalidates assertion state and the exact underlying authority proof in the transaction; missing authority fails closed.

LegalHoldTargetBinding.description: Closed union of thirteen supported immutable legal-hold target bindings. AUDIT_SUBJECT_RECORD is deliberately not a binding because no authoritative source relation exists; placeLegalHold recognizes that discriminator and returns LEGAL_HOLD_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED without writes.

oneOf.description: targetId and targetDigest are exactly the immutable correction snapshot ID and digest; targetVersion is that snapshot version.
targetId and targetDigest are exactly the immutable subscription snapshot ID and digest; targetVersion is that snapshot version.
The common target tuple is exactly intake.communication_endpoints(id, version, endpoint_digest); no derived endpoint snapshot digest is accepted.

VerifyResponseOrganizationIdentityReques.description: Verifies a response organization against one current immutable official-channel authority assertion. The owner revalidates assertion state and the exact underlying authority proof in the transaction; missing authority fails closed.

officialChannelSourceId.description: Identifier of the current immutable official-channel authority assertion. It is never a raw communication endpoint verification ID or official document evidence ID.

sourceId.description: OFFICIAL_DOMAIN_EMAIL selects one current communication_endpoint_verifications.id; OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT selects one current editorial.evidence.id. The caller never supplies an authority receipt ID or digest.
